text: Hastings had come to London to sell a mine, the Gould and Curry Extension, but he had failed, and he was nearly ruined. <break time="0.8s" /> I told him that he could use my name freely to sell the mine, and that we would share the profit equally. <break time="0.8s" /> When people asked me about the mine, I only said, I know the man, and I know the mine, and soon it was sold. <break time="0.8s" /> When the thirty days were over, I put on my best clothes and went to the brothers house with Portia. <break time="0.8s" /> I handed back the note, and Brother B, who had bet on me, cried, I have won. <break time="0.8s" /> Then I showed them a bank certificate for two hundred thousand pounds, my share from the sale of the mine. <break time="0.8s" /> The two old men stared in surprise, and then Portia explained that the winner was her stepfather and the other was her uncle. <break time="0.8s" /> When her stepfather asked me which position I wanted, I took Portias hand and answered, Son in law. <break time="0.8s" /> The note became his wedding present to me, and it has hung in a frame in the most sacred place in our home ever since. <break time="0.8s" /> If I had not stopped to stare at that pear on Portland Place, I would never have found my fortune or my wife.
